scope: Isolated Windows deployment; actual current-user Limited scheduled task calls production cleanupWindowsWorker. No native agent or model is invoked.

failureAndFix.observedFailure: Elevated SSH registration left the Limited task principal with only FR in the default task DACL. Both stopped workers retained their exact owned scheduled tasks and launch descriptors.
failureAndFix.fix: Create this individual task with an explicit protected DACL granting full control to SYSTEM, local Administrators and the exact current-user SID. RunLevel stays Limited; no triggers, password storage or global scheduler ACL changes.
failureAndFix.existingStoppedWorkersRecovered: Two previously stopped exact-owned tasks and descriptors were removed externally using the original production ownership checks; no foreign task was stopped.

windowsUnitRegression.note: This is the final worker subset on the physical Windows host. The earlier 97-test Windows result is a separate frozen run, not summed as new tests.

limits: Requires an existing interactive Windows login; no boot/login trigger is installed.
This verifies task ownership, permission scope and shutdown cleanup; it does not repeat the earlier model conversation.
Private task names, SIDs, native conversation IDs, hostnames and absolute deployment paths are omitted.
